subject: C-Suite Briefing Window & Demo Lockdown — Requesting VP/CTO Attendance
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Ford <alicia.ford@novaforge.com>, Samir Khan <samir.khan@novaforge.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: C-Suite Briefing Window & Demo Lockdown — Requesting VP/CTO Attendance

Hi Alicia / Samir —

Great to connect on the discovery call last week. Per our conversation, we want to lock a short C-suite briefing + hands-on demo with Novaforge leadership to validate integration approach and latency SLAs before the pilot PO is finalized. Proposed plan: a 60-minute session split 20m exec briefing (value + risk/mitigation) + 35m demo + 5m next steps and decision points.

Two tentative slots that work for our engineering and product leads:
- Monday 15 Nov, 10:00 — 11:00 PT
- Tuesday 16 Nov, 13:00 — 14:00 PT

Can you confirm which of those works best for Lila (VP Product) and Markus (CIO)? If the CTO prefers a different format (short intro then deep dive with tech team), we can accommodate — just want to avoid last-minute reschedules.

I've attached a draft mutual action plan and an early SOW draft so leadership has context ahead of the briefing. If you want, Marcus can host a 20-minute pre-brief for your engineering lead to align on integration touchpoints prior to the full session.

Next steps / asks:
- Confirm preferred slot and attendees (VP/CIO/CTO)
- Any key topics to prioritize (integration, security, latency targets, data residency)
- Preferred calendar invite owner and whether we should send an internal-only prep deck first

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mobile: (415) 555-0192
attachments: Novaforge-MAP-v1.pdf, SOW-draft.docx
From: Alicia Ford <alicia.ford@novaforge.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@novaforge.com>
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 11:05:17 -0800
Subject: Re: C-Suite Briefing Window & Demo Lockdown — Requesting VP/CTO Attendance

Tessa —

Thanks, this looks great. Quick update on availability: Lila (VP Product) can make Monday 15 Nov at 10:00 PT. Markus (CIO) is traveling whole week and can't do live on the 15th, but he can join on Tuesday 16 Nov at 13:00 PT. Our CTO (Ravi Patel) is tied up on both dates with an external board commitment.

A couple asks from our side:
- If Markus can't join live, would you be able to record the 15 Nov session and mark a 30-minute follow-up for Tuesday the 16th to cover his questions?
- Can you circulate the run-of-show and the deck 48 hours before the session?
- We'll want to prioritize integration patterns with our data pipeline and a short section on expected per-transaction latency under a 20k qps equivalent (high level).

I'll tentatively hold 15 Nov 10:00 PT for Lila. If you can confirm recording + follow-up slot, we'll lock it and I will send the calendar invite from Novaforge side with Lila invited and Markus marked as tentative for Tue 16.

Cheers,
Alicia
Alicia Ford
Head of Partnerships, Novaforge
Alicia.Ford@novaforge.com

Thanks for the clarity, Alicia — that's helpful. Recording + a 30-minute follow-up for Markus is fine. Proposed approach from our side:
- Hold the primary demo on Mon 15 Nov 10:00 PT (60m) with Lila as primary executive attendee. We'll record the full session.
- Block Tue 16 Nov 13:00 PT — 13:30 PT as a follow-up with Markus to go deeper on the CIO-level questions.
- Run-of-show I'm proposing (will circulate by Thu 12 Nov):
   1) 00:00–00:05 — Quick intros and objective alignment (Tessa / Alicia)
   2) 00:05–00:25 — Executive value briefing (Marcus + Grace)
   3) 00:25–00:55 — Live demo with integration callouts (Marcus, Eng lead)
   4) 00:55–01:00 — Next steps & decision points (Tessa)

I'll attach the current MAP and a SOW draft (same files Tessa shared) and drop a calendar hold from our side for both slots so Novaforge sees them on their calendar. Alicia — once you confirm, we'll send the final deck and an invite link to the recording room.

Internal note: Grace and I will prep a short appendix on latency benchmarking (baseline and targeted optimizations) for the demo.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: Alicia Ford <alicia.ford@novaforge.com>

Subject: Re: C-Suite Briefing Window & Demo Lockdown — Requesting VP/CTO Attendance

Marcus / Tessa —

All right — confirmed on our side.
- Monday 15 Nov, 10:00 — 11:00 PT: Lila Chen (VP Product) attending live — please record the session.
- Tuesday 16 Nov, 13:00 — 13:30 PT: Markus Hale (CIO) tentative follow-up to review the recording and ask targeted questions.

Attendees (Novaforge): Lila Chen (VP Product), Samir Khan (Dir. Eng), Markus Hale (CIO, tentative).

Two final asks before we lock the calendar invite:
1) Please include a brief slide on how Redwood handles KV cache warmup and cold-start latency for short-lived inference bursts. Markus flagged this as a key area.
2) Share the final run-of-show and the 20-slide max deck by Fri 13 Nov EOD so our legal and infra teams can scan ahead of the meeting.

I will send the calendar invite from Novaforge with Lila as organizer and mark Markus as tentative for the Tuesday follow-up. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Alicia

--- Forwarded internal note (Alicia removed) ---
Alicia, thanks — Marcus and Grace, we'll prioritize the KV-cache appendix and toss the deck over by Friday. Tessa, I'll coordinate with Samir to include a short integration diagram for the demo. See you all on Monday.
